text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okay, my next part-time job's at the event hall nearby, so… I'll see you tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whenever I hear "part-time job," I can't help thinking back to that recent conversation…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: …So, basically, Ines's managers want to show her how grateful they are for everything she does!
choice_data_list: And that's why you're planning a thank-you party?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It's going to be totes emosh! Aren't you, like, dying to lend a hand?
choice_data_list: How did you two end up helping out with this?
How did you two end up helping out with this?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: What happened again? Oh yeah, we came by to eat some ramen and the manager was like, "Are you guys friends with Fu?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: And then—get this! She was like, "Someday I'd love to reward her for all her hard work."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Facts! So then we said, "Why wait when we can do it rn?!" And we figured all her other managers would be stoked if they could thank her too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So, yeah, that's how the whole party idea came about.
choice_data_list: Okay, what do you want me to do?
Okay, what do you want me to do?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whoa, are you hype too, Trainer? Yus! Let's make this the most lit party ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, as part of the party prep, I decide to check out Ines Fujin's work ethic for myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm going to take a tiny little peek, that's all. Or at least, that was the plan, but—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Trainer?! What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text: Oh, you know this person, Ines? I found them wandering around the part-time reception area. Would you mind showing this newbie the ropes?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Whaaat! So you are going to work here? You could've just said, you know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While I was scoping out Ines' workplace, I got mistaken for a worker and brought all the way here… But I can't exactly admit that to her.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Well, if you're stumped about anything, just come to me! This venue's kind of special. It's not like at other events.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, in an effort to witness her work ethic up close, I start my shift as a member of the event staff…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: The line is now moving forward! Please don't push while you proceed!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, excuse me! This seat here is available! And it's a good one—you'll get a clear view of the show!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: The food's been delivered, so I laid out all the dishes!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Whoa, you've even portioned out the food! That's a huge help!

text_block_list.name: Comedian
text_block_list.text: It's actually working again! I can't believe how fast you fixed up this mic!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I hope you'll use it to deliver some big laughs to the audience! I'm expecting some killer gags! ♪

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text: I can't thank you enough! I heard you're quite the skilled worker, but you're downright exceptional! It'd be an honor to have you back sometime!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Sure thing! I'll come back once my schedule frees up, so save me some shifts!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Working a shift with Ines Fujin gives me a firm grasp of both her attentive nature and quickness to act.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can definitely see why her managers are so grateful to have her on staff.
choice_data_list: You do a great job of looking out for everyone.
You do a great job of looking out for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks. You weren't half bad yourself, Trainer. ♪
choice_data_list: What's your secret to working so well?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm, my secret… I've never really thought about it that way. I mean, I think personality comes into it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But… I'm guessing that's not the answer you're looking for, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm. If I had to say, I think the secret is to consider what would make people happy!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Whenever I helped out my mom as a kid, she'd be super happy!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And that made me happy too. I remember that fuzzy feeling in my heart being so comforting, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That's when I realized how great it is to make people happy!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Even now, remembering that feeling helps me do my best!
choice_data_list: That's a wonderful mindset to have.
That's a wonderful mindset to have.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Even now, remembering that feeling helps me do my best!
choice_data_list: That's a wonderful mindset to have.
That's a wonderful mindset to have.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Well, I'd say it practically sums up my whole way of life!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: If you didn't think that was like me, we'd have a problem!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I look at Ines Fujin, she almost appears to be glowing against the backdrop of the setting sun.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I know, right?! I think so too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I've got my mom to thank for inspiring me! And I can't thank her enough!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: One day, I really want to repay the favor tenfold. ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: We could go to a hidden hot spring deep in the mountains together—ooh, or a five-star hotel! Wait, an overseas trip could be nice. Hmm, so many options!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The excitement in her voice is infectious, and I can't help but smile as I listen.
